analysis:
The PR changes deadline-admission accuracy in the provider engine bridge. It adds a decode-step shape EWMA (EngineV2Bridge+Measurements.swift:111-125, +RateObservations.swift:16-17,45) and a calibrated isolated-prefill anchor (+RateObservations.swift:55, EngineV2Bridge.swift:325-327). It also adds IsolatedPrefillAdmissionRate.resolve for engines without a recovery probe (+Admission.swift:98-106) and a flag-gated coversObservation reset (+RateObservations.swift:35-40).

I found no regression against the threat model (T-041, TB-007, T-010, T-029).
- No change touches plaintext prompt handling, encryption, attestation, authorization, cache scope/salt, SSD cache storage, or key material.
- engineDecodeShape clamps every value to [1,64] and handles non-finite values. Division by decodeSteps is guarded by decodeSteps > 0. timing.batchRowsSum and timing.mtpProposed are engine-provided, not attacker-supplied. Consumers cannot influence them except through the existing load shape.
- The pre-submit resource release and retirement-transfer paths (+Admission.swift:135-309) are listed in the unit but have no changed ranges in this patch. They look balanced and unchanged, with no new reservation leak.
- The admission rate can be influenced by request mix. A consumer could possibly skew EWMA-based deadline admission and cause refusals (availability). This is a pre-existing class and is not materially worsened here. The anchor appears to limit stuck-low rates.

Unverified external contracts: the implementations of DeadlineAdmissionFixes, IsolatedPrefillAdmissionRate.resolve, CBv2DecodeRateShape, updateDecodeTpsEwma(shape:) and performanceMeasurements.coversObservation/observationAge/keepsNewestObservationTime are outside the supplied evidence. Their handling of NaN, zero and overflow is unreviewed. The default value of DeadlineAdmissionFixes.enabled is also unknown. Low priority for a further pass: confirm that a rate anchor cannot make admission over-permissive (an over-optimistic prefill rate causing admission of requests that cannot meet the deadline, which is an availability and quality concern only).
